query:
insert into TestRunHierarchies (
                        latest_collection,
                        product_id,
                        parent_name,
                        child_name
                    )
                    values (
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3,
                        $4
                    )
                    on conflict (
                        product_id,
                        parent_name,
                        child_name
                    ) do update
                    set
                        latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection
